sentences: rs1800562 is a missense variant in HFE (p.Cys282Tyr) [F2].

The alternate A allele (G>A) is observed in 5.9% of alleles in gnomAD v4 exomes (86298/1461852) and its frequency differs by ancestry, being highest in European (non‑Finnish) at 7.1% (79409/1111990) and lowest in East Asian at 0.018% (7/39700) [F3, F4].
ClinVar classifies this variant as Pathogenic for HFE‑related disorders, hereditary cancer‑predisposing syndrome, and cardiomyopathy, and also records it as a risk factor [F5, F6].
The variant is discussed in the paper titled “Associations of genetically determined iron status across the phenome: A mendelian randomization study” [F9].
